decision_basis: Noncash gains representing 51.31% of PBT weaken 8.54x headline cheapness while borrowings rose 29.4% and net debt reached RM21.818bn. CFO improvement is accepted, but acquisitions/expansion still required material net borrowing; the downtrend adds timing risk.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: earnings distortion and measured financed expansion outweigh actual operating-cash improvement at current entry economics.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
